answer: Stop sybils with a lantern anchor: each agent anchors one identity to a 50-unit bond and one lantern beacon emitting a daily proof. Verifiers slash the bond if one lantern lights two identities or a proof is missing at the nadir audit, the lowest-activity check. Forging 1,000 costs 50,000 units and 1,000 beacons, 1,000× one honest entry, since a beacon cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents anchor once and earn undiluted fees.
